description_expanded:
Located in the newest gulf front condominium residence in Alys Beach, From the moment you arrive at Easterly 101, you will be transported to a place of simplicity and beauty. A well-appointed kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances adds luxury to this beach getaway. The bedroom offers a king-sized bed with ensuite bath and the living room features a sleeper sofa. This condo is the ideal vacation oasis steps away from the pristine beach and the pure emerald waters. Private parking for one vehicle is reserved in front of the condo. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding Easterly 101. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
